fusions.name: Forearm Bash
fusions.desc: Bashes with a raised forearm for 12 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Bruised] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Guarded Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves forward behind both forearms, dealing 4 damage to everything in a short cone. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Forearms
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Braced Line
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
